title: Bug: pfwd/test_nhop_group.py::test_nhop_group_interface_flap fails on v6-only topos
author: wrideout-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

pfwd/test_nhop_group.py has not yet been fully implemented for v6-only topologies, and as such fails the test_nhop_group_interface_flap case wtih "No IP interface found".  All other cases of this test have been skipped via conditional-mark for v6-only topos, so it would seem this case was simply missed.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test pfwd/test_nhop_group.py::test_nhop_group_interface_flap on a v6-only topology.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test cast should be skipped, as all others are also skipped for v6-only topologies.

### Relevant log output

```shell
duthosts = [<MultiAsicSonicHost qspf203>]
enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname = 'qspf203'
tbinfo = {'auto_recover': True, 'comment': 'Tests Arista Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-C448O16', 'conf-name': 'ardut', 'duts': ['qspf203'], ...}
ptfadapter = <tests.common.plugins.ptfadapter.ptfadapter.PtfTestAdapter testMethod=runTest>
gather_facts = {'dst_host_ipv6': 'fc00::2', 'dst_port': ['Ethernet0'], 'dst_port_ids': [0], 'dst_router_intf_name': 'Ethernet0', ...}
enum_rand_one_frontend_asic_index = None
fanouthosts = {'qsp513': { os: 'eos', hostname: 'qsp513', device_type: 'FanoutLeaf' }, 'qsp514': { os: 'eos', hostname: 'qsp514', device_type: 'FanoutLeaf' }}

    def test_nhop_group_interface_flap(duthosts, enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname, tbinfo, ptfadapter,
                                       gather_facts, enum_rand_one_frontend_asic_index, fanouthosts):
        """
        Test for packet drop when route is added with ECMP and all ECMP member's
        interfaces are down. Use kernel flag 'arp_evict_nocarrier' to disable ARP
        eviction from the kernel when the interface goes down.
        Kernel flag is used to easily recreate the scenario of ECMP with no
        Nexthop members. Without this kernel flag, static route addition fails when
        Nexthop ARP entries are not resolved.
        """
        duthost = duthosts[enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname]
        asic = duthost.asic_instance(enum_rand_one_frontend_asic_index)
    
        # Check Gather facts IP Interface is active one
        ip_ifaces = asic.get_active_ip_interfaces(tbinfo).keys()
>       pytest_assert(len(ip_ifaces), "No IP interfaces found")
E       Failed: No IP interfaces found
```

Fixes #23630

On v6-only topolgies, skip ipfwd/test_nhop_group.py as the test has not yet been implemented to support ipv6 addresses or nexthop groups.  All other test cases were already skipped due to the following PR-- this change just adds the last remaining case.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
This was uncovered during a full-suite run on topo t1-isolated-v6-d56u1-lag.  The passrate was negatively impacted, and it was noted that this is was the only test case of the ipfwd/test_nhop_group.py test which was not covered by a conditional mark.

#### How did you do it?
Enhance the existing conditional mark entry to include expecting test failure on v6-only topologies.

#### How did you verify/test it?

> hi @wrideout-arista this issue was opened for more than 70 days, do you have a plan to fix it? #20731, I would think we should have a testgap to address it, other than just xfail. @davidm-arista FYI.
> 
> @r12f @opcoder0 could you help to take a look and comment?

This test was originally skipped on v6-only in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/20750.  The changes in this PR should have been included there for complete coverage.

The changes necessary to address all cases in this test in order to support v6-only topologies are nontrivial and currently targeted for master.

As 202511 stands (the real reason we want to merge this) the conditional-mark coverage is incomplete, and we need to remedy that.
